capabilities: Highlight and comment on text and images without modifying the original file
Track repeated encounters with a passage as hit counts
Resurface unvisited marks in a review panel grouped by time
Store annotations in one sidecar file per annotated file
Open notes in reading mode by folder or frontmatter exception
disambiguation: Not a focus-tracking or time-management tool; 'attention' means marks and comments on passages you can revisit.
extras: No further updates; install Media One instead, which takes over Attention's settings. Design details are in docs/architecture.md, not the README.
problem: Obsidian's highlight syntax edits the note to exist, can't carry comments or a revisit history, and review tools resurface whole notes rather than the specific passages you marked.

relations.evidence: Attention is now part of Media One, as its Annotations module.
PDFs, when PDF++ is installed: select text and Mark or 💬 it
markdown notes and — when Media Transcript is installed — its transcript panel
using the same keys as the Force note view mode plugin

summary: Annotation plugin that records highlights and comments on notes, PDFs and transcripts in sidecar files, then resurfaces marked passages.
